setting: A bounded, hand-free instructional scene with a visibly disordered source area on the left and an empty orderly display board on the right: eight equal, clearly separated board spaces in a single row. The helper is a local neutral agent, not a named or recurring character.
initial_state_or_goal: The initial page visibly shows exactly eight immutable picture cards—cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, and napkin—scattered and overlapping in the source area, while all eight board spaces are empty. The obvious problem is that the cards are disordered; the visible goal is an orderly board with one card in each space. Every card contains the exact same reviewed photograph of its object kind on every page.
meaningful_development: In one connected eight-step event, the neutral helper organizes the same eight cards one at a time in frozen order cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, napkin. Each page visibly preserves every card exactly once: cards already handled are in distinct board spaces, the next card is visibly being placed into the next empty board space, and remaining cards stay visible in the disordered source area. The board spaces are equal display spaces, not object-specific matching locations; no relation is asserted beyond organizing one card per space. No card is redrawn, substituted, duplicated, hidden, fused, or identity-shifted.
resolution_or_stopping_state: The terminal page visibly shows all eight unchanged picture cards arranged neatly, one per board space, with the source area empty. The neutral helper is visibly celebrating the completed orderly display with a simple raised-arms gesture and nonverbal celebratory marks. The event stops at this resolved organization. No character identity, ownership, use, food, material, color category, matching location, spatial vocabulary, direction, order vocabulary, or interface knowledge is established or scored.

scored_story_claims: The eight cards remain eight distinct object-kind representations while a neutral helper organizes them from a disordered source area into an orderly display board.
